metadata.title: Fired By My Own Son-In-Law
metadata.subtitle: My daughter's fiancé fired me from the mailroom on livestream—until the $80M buyout contract required my fingerprint.

nodes.text: 2:00 PM · Apex Tech Lobby. Working incognito as a mailroom clerk to observe your future son-in-law, you hand Kyle a courier envelope—only for him to shove a livestream camera in your face.
Chat, look at this lazy mailroom dinosaur! Thirty seconds late with my $80M acquisition binder—you’re FIRED! Security, dump his box outside!
Kyle, stop the camera! That’s my parent, {{player_name}}! You promised to respect my family!
Keep quiet, Sophia! Once Vanguard Capital signs this $80M buyout at 4 PM, I don’t need a mailroom clerk’s daughter dragging down my brand!
Already booked the penthouse with my new PR girl once the Vanguard wire hits.

nodes.prompt: 40,000 livestream viewers watch Kyle toss your badge on the floor:

options.label: Smile & ask who owns Vanguard Capital
options.player_reply_text: Funny—you’re bragging about Vanguard Capital without knowing their founder’s name.

options.label: Text Ben the CTO to check the binder seal

nodes.text: Kyle laughs loudly for the livestream, totally oblivious to the calm steel in your eyes.
As if a mailroom clerk would ever meet Vanguard’s Chairman! Get out!
You message CTO Ben—the quiet coder Kyle sidelined—and Ben’s reply flashes back in three seconds.
Wait... {{player_name}}?! Your signature watermark is on Vanguard’s term sheet! And Kyle’s been cooking the books!
You gently take Sophia’s hand, leaving Kyle gloating in front of his ring light.
Don’t worry, Sophia. At 4:00 PM sharp, Kyle is going to learn who really signs Vanguard’s checks.

nodes.headline: The 4 PM Signature
nodes.teaser_text: Kyle thinks he’s two hours away from an $80M payday—he doesn’t know the Vanguard Chairman is the mailroom clerk he just fired live.

nodes.text: 2:20 PM · Coffee shop across the street. Co-founder Ben rushes in looking over his shoulder.
Ben whispers: "Chairman {{player_name}}, I’m at the corner booth! Kyle inflated user metrics by 400% to scam Vanguard!"
Urgent message pops up: "Kyle faked $12M in revenue invoices! Meet me at the back booth!"
Inflated revenue AND humiliating my daughter on livestream? Show me the real ledger, Ben.

nodes.caption: Stamped audit ledger: $12M phantom invoices routed through Kyle’s brother’s shell agency.

nodes.prompt: Ben asks if he’ll be ruined when the buyout collapses:

options.label: Promise to back Ben’s own clean startup
options.player_reply_text: Honest builders never lose with Vanguard. I’ll fund your next venture personally.

options.label: Make Ben interim CEO once Kyle is arrested

nodes.text: Relief washes over Ben’s face as he hands you the encrypted USB containing every fake invoice.
Thank you, Chairman! I’ll testify to every single forged entry.
You draft a conditional Vanguard board memo: remove Kyle for fraud, acquire the real tech directly from Ben.
Wait—you’ll still save our 80 engineers’ jobs?! Count me 100% in!
Sophia wipes her eyes and glances at her phone—Kyle’s livestream clip just hit 500,000 views.
Sophia, stop sulking. Tell your mailroom parent to stay off the block—Vanguard’s motorcade arrives in 45 minutes!

nodes.headline: The Motorcade Arrives
nodes.teaser_text: Kyle rolls out the red carpet for Vanguard’s Chairman—having no clue he’s rolling it out for the man he just fired.

nodes.text: 3:45 PM · Apex Tech Plaza. Press cameras line the red carpet as five black limousines glide up—and Kyle rushes to open the center door.
Welcome to Apex Tech, Chairman Vanguard! It is the honor of my life to—WAIT A SECOND!!
Nice red carpet, Kyle. Good thing I’m not thirty seconds late this time.

nodes.transcript: [stammering wildly on live mic] "N-no! Security! That mailroom clerk stole the Chairman’s limo! Grab him!"

nodes.text: Someone turn off the livestream!! Turn it off RIGHT NOW!!

nodes.prompt: Press reporters recognize your face from Forbes Magazine:

options.label: Wave at Kyle’s own livestream camera
options.player_reply_text: Hey chat! Looks like the "mailroom dinosaur" brought the $80M checkbook.

options.label: Ask Kyle why he canceled Sophia’s wedding

nodes.text: The livestream comment feed explodes at 10,000 messages per second as viewers realize the truth!
Haha! Chat is roasting him nonstop! Look at his face!
You step right beside Kyle’s microphone: "Earlier you said you didn’t need a mailroom clerk’s daughter. Still feel that way?"
No!! It was a prank video! Sophia, tell {{player_name}} we were filming a viral skit!
You walk straight past Kyle’s trembling handshake and head up to the 20th-floor signing room.
Bring your binder upstairs, Kyle. Let’s talk about the fingerprint required on page 12.

nodes.headline: Page 12
nodes.teaser_text: Kyle prays you’ll still sign the $80M buyout to save face—unaware that Ben just handed your auditors the smoking gun.

nodes.text: 4:00 PM · Boardroom 20A. The $80M digital contract glows on the biometric tablet—awaiting your thumbprint.
Chairman {{player_name}}, I beg your forgiveness! Sign the buyout and I’ll marry Sophia tomorrow in Paris!
Keep your Paris wedding, Kyle! I wouldn’t marry you if you were the last man on earth!
Before anyone signs, look at screen 2—our forensic audit of Kyle’s "revenue" just finished.
Ben, you traitor!! How did you unlock my private accounting server?!

nodes.prompt: Your thumb hovers an inch above the biometric scanner:

options.label: Hit REJECT & trigger the fraud audit
Sign a $1 hostile takeover for fraud default

nodes.text: You press the crimson REJECT button. Instantly, Kyle’s bridge lenders flash default notices across his phone.
No! Without Vanguard’s cash, my $15M personal loan defaults in two hours!!
You place your thumb on the Penalty Acquisition tab—invoking the anti-fraud covenant in Vanguard’s bridge note to seize 100% control for $1!
Clean sweep! Vanguard owns Apex Tech’s IP—and Kyle gets zero equity plus a fraud indictment!
Kyle lunges across the glass table toward Ben’s laptop—only for two Vanguard guards to pin him gently to his chair.
Wait! You can’t arrest me—my brother already wired the $12M to an offshore account you’ll never touch!

nodes.headline: The Offshore Trail
nodes.teaser_text: Kyle brags that his $12M loot is untouchable—he doesn’t realize Vanguard owns the clearing bank his brother used.

nodes.text: 4:15 PM · You tap your private banking terminal and pull up the exact offshore wire Kyle’s brother triggered.
Funny you mention Meridian Offshore Bank, Kyle. Vanguard acquired 60% of them last quarter.
WHAT?! No—that’s impossible!!

nodes.caption: Meridian Offshore Compliance Alert: $12M wire frozen pending criminal seizure.

nodes.text: Bro, run to the airport NOW—they froze Meridian!

nodes.prompt: Kyle tries to warn his brother at the airport:

options.label: Alert airport police to intercept his brother
options.player_reply_text: Too late, Kyle. Airport security already flagged his passport.

options.label: Reverse the $12M straight into payroll escrow

nodes.text: Within two minutes, a police dispatch confirms Kyle’s brother was detained at Gate 14.
Both brothers caught! Every cent of the $12M is accounted for!
You tap Reverse Wire. The entire $12M bounces back into Apex Tech’s verified payroll and R&D trust.
The money just hit our clean account! Our engineers are saved!
Economic-crime officers enter Boardroom 20A as Kyle’s PR girlfriend slips quietly out the back door.
Wait—where is Chloe going?! She swore she loved me!!

nodes.headline: Abandoned In Cuffs
nodes.teaser_text: Kyle is led out in handcuffs past the same lobby where he fired you two hours ago—and his livestream is still recording.

nodes.text: 4:40 PM · Apex Tech Lobby. Eighty employees line the marble atrium as officers escort Kyle out.
Remember when you told the livestream I’d drag down your brand, Kyle? Look who’s trending #1 now.
Sophia, please! Tell your parent to drop the criminal charge—I’ll sign over my apartment!

nodes.transcript: [addressing the lobby] "Everyone, meet our new majority owner, Chairman {{player_name}}! Nobody is losing their job!"

nodes.text: I can’t believe I almost married that fraud...

nodes.prompt: The lobby erupts in cheers as Kyle begs one last time:

options.label: Let the law handle him & address staff
options.player_reply_text: Take him away, Officers. Now let’s rebuild Apex Tech properly.

options.label: Hand him a cardboard box for his desk stuff

nodes.text: You step to the center of the lobby and announce immediate bonuses for every overworked clerk and engineer.
The mailroom team is literally crying tears of joy right now!
You hand the officer Kyle’s golden nameplate inside the exact cardboard box he tossed at your feet two hours ago.
Karma hit me like a freight train...
Just as the cheers settle, Ben pulls you aside with an alarmed look on his face.
Chairman, wait—I found a hidden backdoor in Kyle’s server! Someone outside Apex helped him forge the audit!

nodes.headline: The Hidden Backdoor
nodes.teaser_text: Kyle didn’t act alone—a senior partner inside Vanguard Capital was secretly splitting the $12M kickback with him.

nodes.text: 5:15 PM · Server Room. Ben traces the encrypted approval key that bypassed Vanguard’s usual due diligence.
Ben gasps: "The approval token belongs to Vanguard’s Managing Director—he fast-tracked Kyle’s fake buyout for a $4M kickback!"
Urgent log flashes: "Vanguard Managing Director bypassed audit controls for a $4M side payment!"
So that’s why he pushed me to sign without visiting Apex Tech in person. Good thing I went undercover in the mailroom.

nodes.transcript: [sharp realization] "Wait—he’s hosting the Vanguard investor dinner at 7 PM tonight! If he deletes the logs first..."

nodes.prompt: Your corrupt Managing Director is about to wipe Vanguard’s audit logs:

options.label: Snapshot the server & lock his admin key
options.player_reply_text: Ben, mirror the logs to police cloud and revoke his credentials.

options.label: Feed him fake logs to catch him red-handed

nodes.text: Ben’s fingers fly across the keyboard. The evidence locks safely behind triple-encrypted legal custody.
Locked and archived! He can’t erase a single byte now.
You leave a honey-pot file open—and watch his executive IP attempt to delete it live from the banquet hall!
GOTCHA! Obstruction of justice logged with timestamp and biometric ID!
You button your tailored jacket. Time to crash your own Managing Director’s VIP dinner.
Two birds, one undercover shift. Let’s go clean house.

nodes.headline: The Investor Dinner
nodes.teaser_text: At 7 PM, the corrupt Managing Director toasts to his "brilliant deal"—right before you walk in with Ben and the police.

nodes.text: 7:00 PM · Vanguard Private Gala. Your Managing Director raises his glass, praising the "flawless $80M Apex deal."
Flawless? Funny—I spent two weeks in their mailroom and found $12M in fake invoices and your $4M kickback.
And here’s your biometric deletion attempt from twenty minutes ago on the big screen!

nodes.transcript: [cheering softly] "Every investor in the room just stood up to applaud {{player_name}}! He’s done!"

nodes.text: Best corporate sting operation in history!

nodes.prompt: Police escort the stunned Managing Director away:

options.label: Reassure investors & announce full audit
options.player_reply_text: Vanguard protects honest capital. Zero tolerance for fraud at any level.

options.label: Appoint Ben as Apex CEO live on stage

nodes.text: Institutional investors erupt into thunderous applause, pledging $200M more to Vanguard’s new fund.
Integrity isn’t a slogan—it’s the foundation.
You call Ben up to the podium and hand him the CEO contract for the newly reorganized Apex Tech.
I won’t let you or our 80 engineers down, Chairman {{player_name}}!
Sophia links her arm through yours, beaming with pride as the press flashes brighten the room.
Best plot twist ever. Who needs a fake fiancé when you have a legendary parent?

nodes.headline: The Rebound
nodes.teaser_text: With the fraudsters purged, Apex Tech’s real product is ready to shock the entire industry.

nodes.text: 10:00 AM · One week later. Apex Tech launches Ben’s genuine AI engine—with zero fake metrics.
Chairman! Real organic signups just hit 2 million in 48 hours! Valuation already doubled past $160M!
Turns out real engineering beats livestream bragging every single time.

nodes.transcript: [laughing warmly] "And guess who’s running our brand-new Community Fellowship? Me! Plus Ben asked me out for real coffee!"

nodes.text: Saw Apex Tech hit $160M on the prison TV... I threw away everything.

nodes.prompt: Ben asks if you approve of him taking Sophia to coffee:

options.label: Give your blessing with a warm grin
options.player_reply_text: You already passed the hardest test, Ben. Treat her well.

options.label: Joke that he has to pass a mailroom shift first

nodes.text: Ben grins from ear to ear while Sophia blushes brightly beside the conference glass.
Promise, Chairman {{player_name}}!
Both Ben and Sophia burst out laughing as you toss Ben your old blue mailroom badge.
Deal! I’ll sort every envelope in the building by 8 AM!
From the 20th-floor window, sunlight spills across the plaza where your undercover journey began.
One last toast tonight at home—just family and friends!

nodes.headline: The Celebration
nodes.teaser_text: Tonight the mailroom legend takes a bow—surrounded by the people who earned it.

nodes.text: 7:30 PM · Vanguard Rooftop Garden. The entire mailroom crew, Ben, and Sophia raise their glasses under warm fairy lights.
To Chairman {{player_name}}—who proved you can judge a person’s whole soul by how they treat the mailroom!
And to the real builders of Apex Tech. Every single person here earned their share of this victory.

nodes.transcript: [clinking glasses] "Cheers! Best livestream plot twist in history!"

nodes.text: Still can’t believe I’m CEO and dating Sophia. Best week ever.

nodes.prompt: Final toast under the city stars:

options.label: Toast to truth & second chances
options.player_reply_text: To honesty, hard work, and never judging a cover!

options.label: Grant every mailroom clerk Vanguard stock

nodes.text: Cheers echo across the rooftop as the skyline sparkles in celebration.
Love you, {{player_name}}! Never change!
You announce an equity grant for the entire support staff—turning every mailroom clerk into a shareholder!
Standing ovation! You’re the greatest Chairman alive!
The city glows golden below—a reminder that true power never needs to shout.
Shift complete. Enjoy the evening, everyone.

nodes.headline: Finale · Undercover Crown
nodes.teaser_text: Kyle and the crooked partner face prison, Apex Tech soars under honest leadership, and Sophia found happiness.
